Subject: mechanism design | ID: 12818

Proof

Step 3. By compactness of the parabolic spectral family \(U_{01300013}\), the image is precompact in the symmetric space topology.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via spectral interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
